### Packages

```{r}
#install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

```
## Import data

```{r}
read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
penguins <- read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
```

## Data wrangling


```{r}
penguins |> count(island) |> arrange(n)

penguins |> relocate(year, .after = island) |> head()

penguins |> arrange (body_mass)
penguins |> arrange(desc(flipper_len)) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(species, bill_len)
penguins |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()
penguins |> arrange(desc(body_mass)) |> relocate(island, .after = body_mass) |> head()


```
